text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A while after friction began to develop 
within the team, an incident occurred.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Due to a minor action by Rice Shower, it 
turns into an impromptu race against Team 
First with the grounds on the line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the handicap where winning just 
one race would count as a victory, all of 
them were defeated. Even Rice Shower, 
carrying their final hopes, suffered a 
crushing loss...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the bet was called off, but 
Rice Shower remained downcast, unable to 
regain her spirits.
